meta.notes:
4-Flow Brainstorm & Briefing Suite:

Flow 1: Morgen-Briefing (Mo–Fr 07:30)
→ Supabase Leads + Jarvis Missions → Claude claude-opus-4-7 → Telegram

Flow 2: Abend-Report (Mo–Fr 18:00)
→ Supabase heutige Missions → Claude Haiku → Telegram

Flow 3: Wochen-Brainstorm (Sonntag 19:00)
→ Supabase Wochen-Missions → Claude claude-opus-4-7 → Telegram

Flow 4: On-Demand Content-Ideen (POST /content-ideas)
→ Gemini 1.5 Flash → JSON → Response

SETUP:
1) SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_ANON_KEY als n8n Env-Vars
2) TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID als n8n Env-Var
3) GEMINI_API_KEY als n8n Env-Var (Google AI Studio: aistudio.google.com)
4) Anthropic Credentials (claude-opus-4-7 + claude-haiku-4-5-20251001)
5) Telegram Bot Credentials
6) Workflow aktivieren (Production Mode)

Gemini API Key:
→ https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey
→ Kostenlos bis 15 RPM / 1M Tokens/Tag

Tabellen müssen existieren:
- outreach_leads (für Morgen-Briefing-Kontext)
- jarvis_missions (für alle Flows)

Content-Ideen Endpoint:
POST https://n8n.deine-domain.de/webhook/content-ideas
{ "topic": "n8n Automatisierung", "pillar": "Bot-Empire", "format": "LinkedIn Post" }
